name: Numbers Beat Words
description: Tuning controllers for strongly coupled multi-input multi-output (MIMO) processes is difficult because decentralized auto-tuning ignores loop interaction and local optimization is start-sensitive. We benchmark whether on-premise open-weight large language models (LLMs) provide useful structural priors, while testing classical alternatives that may make them unnecessary. On a single-loop CSTR, relay-feedback tuning outperforms the LLM.
